description: italki is an easy and flexible way to learn languages through one-on-one online lessons and group classes with native teachers. Customize your learning experience to fit your schedule, level, goals, and budget, and pay per lesson with flexible class lengths. With 150+ languages and thousands of qualified teachers to choose from, italki helps you learn through real communication.

defaultPrompt: I want to practice English with native speakers.
I want to learn English in a group so I can meet more language learners.
I want to test my French level before I start learning.
